sources.evidence_summary: The issuer explicitly includes Ventimiglia, Italy among bordering-country stations covered by a pass valid in France. Its regional TER section describes pass travel without routine reservations. This evidence is restricted here to the published SNCF C3 coastal service whose only Italian call is Ventimiglia.
The issuer describes Lyon-Geneva TER and Annecy-Geneva Léman Express as pass-covered alternatives without reservations.
The issuer's 2026 Swiss validity map shows the Geneva regional corridors to Annemasse, Coppet, the airport and La Plaine as included.
The 2026 operator map identifies L4 Coppet-Annemasse, L7 Geneva Airport/Vernier-Annemasse, and Geneva-Bellegarde regional trains towards Lyon, Grenoble and Valence.
The operator identifies RE33 Annemasse-Geneva-Martigny-St-Maurice. The issuer's 2026 validity map includes the Annemasse-Geneva corridor.
The issuer includes Zurich S-Bahn except S4, S10 and S18. This extension is restricted to the independently identified SBB S9 corridor.
The municipality identifies S9 Schaffhausen-Uster via Jestetten, Lottstetten, Rafz and Zurich.
CFL identifies its cross-border Coradia service to Arlon and SNCB responsibility on the Belgian section. Both named national carrier/product inventories are included by the issuer.

The operator lists Eurail and Interrail as free travel on RhB trains, including Bernina Express; panoramic reservations are purchased separately. The 2026 issuer validity map explicitly includes St. Moritz-Bernina-Tirano.
SNCF TER and Léman Express, Luxembourg CFL Regionalbahn/Intercity, and Belgian SNCB local/Intercity are included in the Global Pass column.

The operator explicitly grants a 100% fare discount with a valid Eurail/Interrail pass on domestic and EU international routes. Vilnius–Riga in both directions is specifically listed with a mandatory EUR5 seat reservation in first and second class.

The exact Vilnius–Riga route has an explicit Eurail/Interrail section requiring a seat reservation (EUR5 in first and second class). Local tickets are not sold between Jelgava and Riga; through journeys remain eligible.

The issuer's Spain page identifies Rodalies regional connections from Barcelona to the French frontier stations La Tor de Querol-Enveitg/Latour-de-Carol and Cerbère as pass-network alternatives to high-speed services. The same page distinguishes the excluded Euskotren network and describes regional travel without routine reservations. Apply only to the recorded Renfe/Rodalies services at those exact French terminal calls.

The issuer's Swiss validity map names Konstanz as the German end of THURBO's free-ride lines. Evidence is restricted to that station; the map draws other lines beyond the frontier in grey and is not used for them. (It also names Erzingen (Baden) on the DB Schaffhausen line, which needs no rule; see withdrawn.)

The issuer's Slovakia page lists REX 6 and REX 8 between Bratislava and Vienna under 'Train types / International Trains', without naming a carrier; the page itself does not say these trains are covered by the pass. Pass coverage rests on the issuer's company table (ZSSK, and the ÖBB and GYSEV REX rows marked √); this page fixes the two lines and their stations. Restricted here to REX-labelled trains whose host-country calls are all stations of those two lines.

Coordinator decision D1 (12 Nov 2026): a line the issuer's Swiss map draws red counts as line evidence for any carrier's train on it, encoded line by line with exact host stations, no extrapolation beyond drawn segments. Segments read at 600 dpi: Chiasso–Lugano–Bellinzona–Biasca–Airolo, Mendrisio–Stabio, Bellinzona/Cadenazzo–Locarno, Cadenazzo–Luino (Swiss part) red; Buchs SG and St. Margrethen red, lines beyond toward Feldkirch/Bregenz grey; Basel SBB–Basel Bad Bf red, Basel SBB–St-Louis grey (Basel St. Johann excluded); Schaffhausen red; Geneva CEVA (Lancy-Bachet–Champel–Eaux-Vives–Chêne-Bourg) red; La Chaux-de-Fonds–Le Locle red, beyond Le Locle grey (Le Locle-Col-des-Roches excluded); Vallorbe red. Any issuer text excluding a carrier prevails.
